text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How'd ya get so many?! Ya got<n>some serious
talent for this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take a pic with all these<n>and put it on
Umatter! My followers<n>are in for a big shock!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right. You should get in the pic<n>with the Cuties,
too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who got 'em, after all.<n>It's a
boss's duty to reward her<n>lackeys for their good
work!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: MWAHAHAHA! You better keep up<n>the good work!
